name: nodeUp
description: Search LinkedIn jobs and profiles from any AI assistant. Browser-based scraping — no API keys needed.
long_description: A production-grade MCP server for LinkedIn job search and profile scraping. Uses browser-based scraping via Patchright (stealth Playwright) so no API keys are required. Supports job filters for location, job type, experience level, remote/onsite, and skills, plus person tools for profile scraping, people search, sidebar recommendations, and connection requests.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search for jobs with filters (query, location, job_type, experience_level, location_type, skills)

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific job by its provider-prefixed ID

tools.name: get_person_profile
tools.description: Scrape a LinkedIn profile and optional detail sections

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Scrape the authenticated user's own LinkedIn profile

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Search LinkedIn people and return raw page text for parsing

tools.name: get_sidebar_profiles
tools.description: Extract sidebar recommendation profile links from a profile page

tools.name: connect_with_person
tools.description: Send a LinkedIn connection request with an optional note

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check server status and which job providers are online

linkedin_browser_headless.title: Run Browser Headless
linkedin_browser_headless.description: Run the LinkedIn scraping browser in headless mode (recommended)

linkedin_client_id.title: LinkedIn API Client ID
linkedin_client_id.description: Optional — only needed if you have LinkedIn API access

linkedin_client_secret.title: LinkedIn API Client Secret
linkedin_client_secret.description: Optional — only needed if you have LinkedIn API access
